objet: Documents required for our review of your French tax position
disponibilite: We remain at your disposal for any question.

corps.p: I thank you for your time on the call this morning.

Our review will cover each year since your arrival. It will fix your residency status under French law and under the France-United States tax treaty of 31 August 1994, the French returns that may have been due for those years, and your IFI position. The list below completes the shorter one sent to you earlier today.
Could you send us the following?

corps.b: a copy of your passport, identity pages and every page carrying a French visa or an entry stamp
each residence permit held since your arrival in France, renewals included
your certificates of enrolment for each academic year since your arrival
the elements of your talent passport application, if it has already been prepared
an approximate calendar of your presence in France for each year since your arrival, your own estimate is enough
your leases and rent receipts for each period of accommodation in France
your French electricity, internet or mobile telephone contracts, whichever you have kept
your United States federal income tax returns for the last three years, with all schedules
your California state returns for the same years
any French return you have filed and any French tax notice you have received, including a notice showing no tax due
your French tax number, if one has been allocated to you
your internship agreements, employment contracts and French payslips for the work carried out in France
the purchase deed, together with the loan documents if the property is financed
your exact share of the property, and the way it is held, whether directly, through a trust or through a limited liability company
the constitutive documents of that trust or company, where the property is held through a structure
a recent valuation or, failing that, your own estimate of the current value
details of any other real estate you own, in France or abroad
a list of your bank and investment accounts held outside France, showing the institution, the country and the type of account
the annual statements of those accounts for the last three years
the highest balance reached on each of those accounts during each of those years
a list of the accounts you hold in France
your date of birth and your current address in France
your marital status and, where applicable, the country of residence of your spouse or partner

corps.p: Once these items have reached us, we will complete our review and revert with a proposal setting out each of the two steps discussed on the call, with the corresponding fixed fee. Anything still missing at that stage can follow later, and we will come back to you if we need it.
